scope: Current unified-semantic-graph Tasks. R4.3-024/025 supersedes older Protocol/dry-run/translation-proof execution requirements. Historical retained runs and evidence are not rewritten or automatically resumed.

request.candidate_ref: run-relative immutable stage3-neutral-graph/candidates/<candidate>-r<revision>.json, or null for supported fields-only changes including Class/relation_type creation
request.changes: nonempty ordered list of the closed change shape below

arguments.request_ref: alternative to request: {material_id, optional path} returned by publish_handoff_material to recipient_id=runner; path selects one directory file member, not a JSON Pointer
arguments.placement_ref: optional {artifact_ref,path} copied from a Host-confirmed frozen ontology-plan entry; omit when placement is already unambiguous

request_input.selection: Supply exactly one of request or request_ref; omit the unused key rather than setting it to null. Both use the same complete r4-3-025-model-changes/v1 object and compiler/application path. candidate_ref inside that object selects a candidate, not the complete request document.
request_input.prepared_request: Write the complete request JSON once with write_handoff_output, publish that source to recipient_id=runner, then submit its returned material reference. Do not retype a correct prepared request into a second tool argument. Inline request remains valid for short new changes.
request_input.content: The file is the complete request object with schema_version, candidate_ref and changes; it is not a wrapper containing modeling_id/request, a candidate-only artifact, a command plan or an arbitrary local path. A directory reference must select its request file with path.
request_input.binding: The current Modeling actor must have published this immutable material to runner. The existing material channel checks current run, source/recipient authorization, manifest and member digest. The program loads the full selected JSON once; editing or deleting the author's source does not change published bytes.
request_input.execution: The resolved content enters the existing canonical submission snapshot and digest, compiler, write admission, atomic apply and receipt flow. Input transport does not change semantic submission identity: inline/reference retries of the same content reuse the original success or uncertain-write reconciliation. No field repair, content dropping or semantic inference is implied.
request_input.errors: Missing/changed/forbidden material, missing directory member or invalid JSON returns typed retryable not_written feedback at /request_ref before any model write. Invalid request contents retain existing compiler paths and diagnostics; correct and republish within the same goal.

rules: change_id is a unique neutral operation label. item_id selects the complete current candidate item; fields is null. fields-only existing modifications use item_id=null. Do not copy a candidate into fields.

create selects a candidate item for the seven unified kinds; target_ref=null. Supported Class/relation_type/Operation/Mapping create uses item_id=null, target_ref=null and fields containing its semantic fields. update/delete/fact operations require a concrete retained target_ref. Missing candidate items never imply deletion.

target_ref and existing_resource_ref are {artifact_ref,path}; path is a JSON Pointer to one actual authorized governed response or applied receipt entry. No bare guessed resource IRI/ID, Session, lease, version, Batch identity, command_kind, payload envelope or command plan.
Ontology placement comes from the confirmed topology and trusted run scope, not from guessed table/slice counts. An unresolved placement is a fixable scope_binding_required error.

value_rules.entity: create_entity semantic fields; label required, no fabricated Class. Class references use definition_ref or authorized existing_resource_ref. properties uses [{property_ref,value}] with unique property refs. Preserve optional semantic_definition/action_definition/parameter_definition.
value_rules.property: name required; explicit predicate_kind=fact|relation. fact requires datatype. datatype and object_class_id are mutually exclusive. Only semantic_definition annotation is supported.
value_rules.relation: value={predicate: definition_ref or existing_resource_ref}; relation_endpoints={from_item_id,to_item_id}. Preserve explicit direction. No silent relation annotation loss: express additional local conditions with ordinary nodes as appropriate.
value_rules.table_mapping/join_mapping/enum_meaning/: Use existing current batch create business fields, without technical resource identity. Resolve references only in declared reference slots. Do not introduce SQL/DSN/source_id/run_id import variants.

candidate.unknowns: Preserve business_meaning and all declared unknowns in supported semantic_definition fields; conflicting same-name meanings are errors. Candidate-level explicit_unknowns remain in submission/handoff gaps; execution success alone never proves they are retrievable or the whole scenario is complete.
candidate.legacy_value: A legal old value that cannot uniquely compile requires an explicit new immutable revision; the program does not guess or rewrite the old artifact.

semantic_level: entity/create_entity creates an owl:NamedIndividual, including when no Class is supplied. An asserted relation between individuals states an instance fact. Class/relation_type definitions are available as fields-only changes for concept-level semantics; do not force concepts into individuals or invent candidate kinds. A complete immutable fields-only change request is a semantic delivery, not a command plan. definition_ref selects a candidate item in this submission, not a fields-only change_id. To connect new fields-only Classes, first create them, then use actual retained receipt entries through existing_resource_ref for the relationship definition. The program executes the selected semantics and does not choose this business distinction for Modeling.
execution: Program compiles all statically checkable input before the first write, preserves candidate item identities and JSON Pointer source maps, orders explicit dependencies, obtains real Session/lease/revision, and calls apply_atomic once per batch. Cross-batch dependencies use successful actual resource outputs. No dry-run, translation approval, or cross-batch transaction claim.

results.rule: Trust applied receipts. Index failed/unknown is separate from write state; never reapply to repair search. Reconcile uncertain original identities before dependent writes. Correct ordinary input errors within the same goal. Preserve actual resource kind, source item/change, Batch/Attempt, revisions, index state and first blocker.
results.resource_references: Each resource_bindings member with observed resource outputs and a retained receipt includes existing_resource_ref={artifact_ref,path}, computed from its actual raw receipt item matched by client_item_id. Select a member by change_id/item_id and copy its reference into target_ref or an existing_resource_ref wrapper. resource_bindings order and request order need not match the raw receipt items order; never construct receipt pointers from their array indexes. These are technical identities, not inferred business endpoints.

self_check: At valuable successful stages query_semantic_context with public questions in explicit authorized ontologies scope, then expand actual returned IRI anchors and full definitions. Current hybrid/adaptive/relevance defaults apply. Preserve revision/index/cursor/completeness and authorization limitations; lexical fallback/no match is not proof of model absence or global completeness.
handoff: Use existing maps/handoffs for submission/query references, findings/dispositions and gaps. Final full governed association check remains required once before handoff, not after every batch. Final Consumer/Judge stays independent and cannot repair the production run. Real modeling starts/repair rounds still require existing user authorization.

fields_only_example.note: Generic supported shape, not scenario business truth. Use actual approved meanings. Each change always has all six outer fields. A later relation_type uses actual returned resource_bindings references selected by change_id; do not copy illustrative locators or infer pointers from positions.

semantic_definition.business_meaning: A declared kind of business object.
semantic_definition.applicability: The approved scope of this business definition; no runtime instance is asserted.

fields_only_example.semantic_role_guidance: Place the confirmed business role inside fields.semantic_definition.semantic_role, never as fields.semantic_role. Resource kinds such as concept/class/instance do not replace object/behavior/rule/business_role/process/data_mapping/interface_mapping; confirmed additional meanings remain allowed. Missing declaration, explicit business unknown and multiple roles are distinct. Move a misplaced declaration into the supported field instead of deleting semantic content to pass validation; verify the actual declaration in the existing governed stage self-check.
fields_only_example.unsupported_field_guidance: Do not add exclusions to semantic_definition; preserve an approved exclusion in supported business_meaning/applicability text. Change identity keys belong outside fields.

semantic_definition.business_meaning: The first declared object kind relates to the second.

existing_model_awareness:
Follow the required Modeling Skill for bounded current-model discovery, semantic comparison and reuse/create/connect/update decisions. Initial discovery explicitly selects the complete authorized ontology_ids set; then read actual candidate IRIs in their own Ontology with context_detail=full. No match, lexical fallback, forbidden or truncated reads are not proof of global absence. Preserve important read revisions, selected/excluded candidates and reasons, real identities and gaps in existing map/handoff. Recheck affected judgments on revision/permission changes; no full-graph preload, search-count gate or semantic approval is added.
Old resources without this run's creation receipts use actual observed entries at /structuredContent/data/items/N or /structuredContent/data/primary_matches/N with artifact_ref=platform_ref.artifact_path. The program checks current scope/revision/full RDF type and canonical native namespace before recovering ID; external IRIs retain IRI-slot support. The Agent never decodes IRIs or reads old runs. Refresh affected old reads after a new write advances revision.
Optional placement_ref selects a Host-confirmed frozen ontology-plan entry, outside the six-field change/fields. It must agree with candidate/target ownership; endpoints do not choose relation ownership. Cross-graph Mapping also needs current owner.reference_ontology_ids. For missing references, report the concrete dependency to Coordinator under Host mapping_reference_direction; the Host prepares only affected owners, preserving existing references. mapping_reference_scope_required is repairable in the same goal; ordinary relation_type has no Mapping gate. Verify new connections and affected old meanings after valuable stages; applied receipts prove application, not independent semantics or net efficiency.

input_correction.request_edits: Optional with request_ref only. Nonempty explicit JSON Patch operations: add/replace require value; remove uses op/path; move requires from/path. JSON Pointers address the complete request body, without a /request prefix. No root replacement. Original immutable material is never changed.
input_correction.on_rejection: A static compiler rejection returns correction.request_ref for the exact rejected body, whether originally inline or referenced, plus optional suggested_edits and per-resource/action field_contracts. Repeated identical inline rejections retain the same reference. An edited body rejected again gets its own reference.
input_correction.selection: Suggestions only move an existing misplaced control value to a missing outer key or remove an exactly equal nested duplicate. They never choose conflicting values, remove unsupported business fields, fill missing semantics or apply themselves. Agent selects all edits explicitly; preserve unsupported meaning using supported fields.
input_correction.execution: Edits apply deterministically to a private copy before the unchanged compiler. Any invalid edit rejects the entire edit list before platform execution. Corrected content determines the original execution identity; changing transport or edits cannot replay successful or bypass uncertain writes. Scope/freeze/application/independent acceptance remain unchanged.
input_correction.limits: JSON syntax errors still require a valid complete JSON source. This is a request-input correction, not a new modeling round, automatic semantic repair or authorization to resume retained runs.
